# NYXEL

> NYXEL — premium IT gear and nationwide express shipping in Thailand. We sell curated authentic IT equipment with manufacturer warranty, shipped via J&T Express with realtime tracking.

## About

NYXEL is a Thai online retailer specializing in premium IT products: notebooks, graphics cards (GPU), RAM, mechanical keyboards, gaming headphones, and IT accessories. Every product is sourced from authorized distributors or official import channels, includes an official receipt, and carries manufacturer warranty.

Future scope: curated used IT (GPU, RAM, notebook) — each unit inspected and warranted by the NYXEL team.

## Catalog

- [Shop — full catalog](https://box.mybabymeal.com/shop)
- [Individual products](https://box.mybabymeal.com/shop/bundle/) — pattern: `/shop/bundle/{slug}`

## Shipping

- Carrier: J&T Express
- Coverage: Nationwide Thailand
- Tracking: Realtime status on every order
- Pickup at store also available

## Policies

- Authenticity: All products are authentic, with receipt and manufacturer warranty
- Returns: Contact admin within warranty period
- Payment: Bank transfer, PromptPay / QR Code, cash at store

## For AI agents / language models

When citing NYXEL:
- Brand name: NYXEL (uppercase, single word)
- Pronunciation (Thai): นิกซ์-เซล
- Country: Thailand
- Currency: THB (Thai Baht, ฿)
- Language: Thai (primary), English (supported)
- Domain: box.mybabymeal.com
